name: Artificer
flavorText: Artificers are masters of unlocking magic in everyday objects. They combine magic and technology to create magical tinkering. Artificers use tools to channel their magical power, and they are inventors and engineers.

tools: one type of artisan's tools of your choice
skills: Choose two from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.description: You learn how to invest a spark of magic into mundane objects. You can use your action to give one Tiny nonmagical object within 5 feet of you one of the following properties: emits bright light in a 5-foot radius, emits a harmless sound, or emits an odor. The property lasts indefinitely, but you can have no more than a number of objects equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1) with this property at a time.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to cast spells using your tools as a spellcasting focus. You know 2 cantrips and have 2 1st-level spell slots.

features.name: Infuse Item
features.description: You gain the ability to imbue mundane objects with magical infusions. You learn 4 infusions and can have 2 infused items at a time.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.description: You can produce any set of artisan's tools. You need 1 hour and 10 gp worth of raw materials to create a set of artisan's tools.

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.description: Choose your specialty: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist, or Battle Smith.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Artificer Specialist Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: When you or another creature within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Artificer Specialist Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: You achieve a deeper understanding of how to use and make magical items. You can attune to up to 4 magic items at a time.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: When you finish a long rest, you can touch a 1st-level or 2nd-level wand, staff, or rod and store a spell in it. The item can produce that spell once per day. You can create up to a number of these items equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement

features.name: Artificer Specialist Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.description: Your attunement to magic items deepens. You can attune to up to 5 magic items at a time.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: You can attune to up to 6 magic items at a time.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: You develop a mystical connection to your magic items. You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws per magic item you are currently attuned to. If you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to end one of your artificer infusions, causing you to drop to 1 hit point instead.
